sql: /* Query 12: filter6_agg1_join2 (player, team, city, manager) */ SELECT manager.nationality, MIN(player.olympic_gold_medals) AS min_player_olympic_gold_medals FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name JOIN manager ON team.ownership = manager.name JOIN city ON team.location = city.city_name WHERE (team.location = 'Brooklyn' AND player.nba_championships < 0) OR (player.team <> 'Detroit Pistons' AND player.draft_pick <> 41) GROUP BY manager.nationality

nationality.description: nationality is the nationality of the team owner (e.g. American).

olympic_gold_medals.description: number of Olympic gold medals the player has won (e.g., 3).
